verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ עוֹדֵ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: Now the Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO veio o Espírito de Deus sobre Azarias, filho de Odede.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אָסָא֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁמָע֕וּנִי אָסָ֖א וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן יְהוָ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶ֣ם עִמּ֔וֹ וְאִֽם־ תִּדְרְשֻׁ֙הוּ֙ יִמָּצֵ֣א לָכֶ֔ם וְאִם־ תַּעַזְבֻ֖הוּ יַעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê lip̄·nê ’ā·sā way·yō·mer lōw šə·mā·‘ū·nî ’ā·sā wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem bih·yō·wṯ·ḵem ‘im·mōw wə·’im- tiḏ·rə·šu·hū yim·mā·ṣê lā·ḵem wə·’im- ta·‘az·ḇu·hū ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So he went out to meet Asa and said to him Listen to me Asa and all Judah and Benjamin The LORD is with you when you are with Him If you seek Him He will be found by you but if you forsake Him He will forsake you
verses.literalPt: E saiu ao encontro de Asa, e disse-lhe: Ouvi-me, Asa, e todo o Judá e Benjamim: O SENHOR está convosco, enquanto vós estais com ele, e, se o buscardes, o achareis; porém, se o deixardes, vos deixará.

verses.original: וְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְלֹ֣א׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֱמֶ֗ת וּלְלֹ֛א כֹּהֵ֥ן מוֹרֶ֖ה וּלְלֹ֥א תוֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·mîm rab·bîm lə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ĕ·meṯ ū·lə·lō kō·hên mō·w·reh ū·lə·lō ṯō·w·rāh
verses.literal: For many years Israel has been without the true God without a priest to instruct them and without the law
verses.literalPt: E Israel esteve por muitos dias sem o verdadeiro Deus, e sem sacerdote que o ensinasse, e sem lei.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ בַּצַּר־ ל֔וֹ עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְבַקְשֻׁ֖הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ baṣ·ṣar- lōw ‘al- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl way·ḇaq·šu·hū way·yim·mā·ṣê lā·hem
verses.literal: But in their distress . . . they turned to the LORD the God of Israel and sought Him and He was found by them
verses.literalPt: Mas quando na sua angústia voltaram para o SENHOR Deus de Israel, e o buscaram, o acharam.

verses.original: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לַיּוֹצֵ֣א וְלַבָּ֑א כִּ֚י מְהוּמֹ֣ת רַבּ֔וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·‘it·tîm hā·hêm ’ên šā·lō·wm lay·yō·w·ṣê wə·lab·bā kî mə·hū·mōṯ rab·bō·wṯ ‘al kāl- yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: In those days there was no safety for travelers . . . because the residents of the lands had . . . many conflicts
verses.literalPt: E naqueles tempos não havia paz, nem para o que saía, nem para o que entrava, mas muitas perturbações sobre todos os habitantes daquelas terras.

verses.original: וְכֻתְּת֥וּ גוֹי־ בְּג֖וֹי וְעִ֣יר בְּעִ֑יר כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲמָמָ֖ם בְּכָל־ צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵut·tə·ṯū ḡō·w- bə·ḡō·w wə·‘îr bə·‘îr kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm hă·mā·mām bə·ḵāl ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Nation was crushed by nation and city by city for God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity
verses.literalPt: Porque nação contra nação e cidade contra cidade se despeda-çavam; porque Deus os perturbara com toda a angústia.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֣ם חִזְק֔וּ וְאַל־ יִרְפּ֖וּ יְדֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ שָׂכָ֖ר לִפְעֻלַּתְכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem ḥiz·qū wə·’al- yir·pū yə·ḏê·ḵem kî yêš śā·ḵār lip̄·‘ul·laṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: But as for you be strong do not be discouraged . . . for your work will be rewarded
verses.literalPt: Mas esforçai-vos, e não desfaleçam as vossas mãos; porque a vossa obra tem uma recompensa.

verses.original: וְכִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אָסָ֜א הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְהַנְּבוּאָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד הַנָּבִיא֒ הִתְחַזַּ֗ק וַיַּעֲבֵ֤ר הַשִּׁקּוּצִים֙ מִכָּל־ אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּמִן־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיְחַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אוּלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵiš·mō·a‘ ’ā·sā had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·han·nə·ḇū·’āh ‘ō·ḏêḏ han·nā·ḇî hiṯ·ḥaz·zaq way·ya·‘ă·ḇêr haš·šiq·qū·ṣîm mik·kāl ’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min ū·min- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lā·ḵaḏ mê·har ’ep̄·rā·yim way·ḥad·dêš ’eṯ- miz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ă·šer lip̄·nê ’ū·lām Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet he took courage and removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim He then restored the altar of the LORD that was in front of the portico of the LORD’s temple
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, Asa estas palavras, e a profecia do profeta Odede, cobrou ânimo e tirou as abominações de toda a terra, de Judá e de Benjamim, como também das cidades que tomara nas montanhas de Efraim, e renovou o altar do SENHOR, que estava diante do pórtico do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֗ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַגָּרִים֙ עִמָּהֶ֔ם מֵאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִשִּׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־ נָפְל֨וּ עָלָ֤יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָרֹ֔ב בִּרְאֹתָ֕ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōṣ ’eṯ- kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min wə·hag·gā·rîm ‘im·mā·hem mê·’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh ū·miš·šim·‘ō·wn kî- nā·p̄ə·lū ‘ā·lāw mî·yiś·rā·’êl lā·rōḇ bir·’ō·ṯām kî- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: And he assembled all Judah and Benjamin along with those from the tribes of Ephraim Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them for great numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him
verses.literalPt: E reuniu a todo o Judá, e Benjamim, e com eles os estrangeiros de Efraim e Manassés, e de Simeão; porque muitos de Israel tinham passado a ele, vendo que o SENHOR seu Deus era com ele.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֥וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לִשְׁנַ֥ת חֲמֵשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū yə·rū·šā·lim ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·lî·šî liš·naṯ ḥă·mêš- ‘eś·rêh lə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ā·sā
verses.literal: So they gathered together in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth . . . year of Asa’s reign
verses.literalPt: E ajuntaram-se em Jerusalém no terceiro mês; no ano décimo do reinado de Asa.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא מִן־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הֵבִ֑יאוּ בָּקָר֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וְצֹ֖אן שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·bə·ḥū Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū min- haš·šā·lāl hê·ḇî·’ū bā·qār šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wə·ṣōn šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm
verses.literal: At that time they sacrificed to the LORD seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from all the plunder they had brought back
verses.literalPt: E no mesmo dia ofereceram em sacrifício ao SENHOR, do despojo que trouxeram, setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בַבְּרִ֔ית לִדְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם בְּכָל־ לְבָבָ֖ם וּבְכָל־ נַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇab·bə·rîṯ liḏ·rō·wōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇām ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šām
verses.literal: Then they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD the God of their fathers with all their heart and soul
verses.literalPt: E entraram na aliança para buscarem o SENHOR Deus de seus pais, com todo o seu coração, e com toda a sua alma;

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִדְרֹ֛שׁ לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יוּמָ֑ת לְמִן־ קָטֹן֙ וְעַד־ גָּד֔וֹל לְמֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lō- yiḏ·rōš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl yū·māṯ lə·min- qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl lə·mê·’îš wə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: And whoever would not seek the LORD the God of Israel would be put to death whether young or old man or woman
verses.literalPt: E de que todo aquele que não buscasse ao SENHOR Deus de Israel, morresse; assim o menor como o maior, tanto o homem como a mulher.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה בְּק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִתְרוּעָ֑ה וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבְשׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū Yah·weh bə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇiṯ·rū·‘āh ū·ḇa·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: They took an oath to the LORD with a loud voice with shouting trumpets and rams’ horns
verses.literalPt: E juraram ao SENHOR, em alta voz, com júbilo e com trombetas e buzinas.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־ יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל־ הַשְּׁבוּעָ֗ה כִּ֤י בְכָל־ לְבָבָם֙ נִשְׁבָּ֔עוּ וּבְכָל־ רְצוֹנָ֣ם בִּקְשֻׁ֔הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶ֑ם וַיָּ֧נַח יְהוָ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·mə·ḥū ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh ‘al- haš·šə·ḇū·‘āh kî ḇə·ḵāl- lə·ḇā·ḇām niš·bā·‘ū ū·ḇə·ḵāl rə·ṣō·w·nām biq·šu·hū way·yim·mā·ṣê lā·hem way·yā·naḥ Yah·weh lā·hem mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath for they had sworn it with all their heart They had sought Him earnestly . . . and He was found by them So the LORD gave them rest on every side
verses.literalPt: E todo o Judá se alegrou deste juramento; porque de todo o seu coração juraram, e de toda a sua vontade o buscaram, e o acharam; e o SENHOR lhes deu repouso ao redor.

verses.original: וְגַֽם־ מַעֲכָ֞ה אֵ֣ם׀ אָסָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הֱסִירָהּ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשְׂתָ֥ה לַאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה מִפְלָ֑צֶת וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־ מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיָּ֕דֶק וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ma·‘ă·ḵāh ’êm ’ā·sā ham·me·leḵ hĕ·sî·rāh mig·gə·ḇî·rāh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh la·’ă·šê·rāh mip̄·lā·ṣeṯ way·yiḵ·rōṯ ’ā·sā ’eṯ- mip̄·laṣ·tāh way·yā·ḏeq way·yiś·rōp̄ bə·na·ḥal qiḏ·rō·wn
verses.literal: King Asa also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole Asa chopped down the pole crushed it and burned it in the Kidron Valley
verses.literalPt: E também a Maaca, sua mãe, o rei Asa depôs, para que não fosse mais rainha, porquanto fizera um horrível ídolo, a Asera; e Asa destruiu o seu horrível ídolo, e o despedaçou, e o queimou junto ao ribeiro de Cedrom.

verses.original: וְהַ֨בָּמ֔וֹת לֹא־ סָ֖רוּ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֧ק לְבַב־ אָסָ֛א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֖ם כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bā·mō·wṯ lō- sā·rū mî·yiś·rā·’êl raq lə·ḇaḇ- ’ā·sā hā·yāh šā·lêm kāl- yā·māw
verses.literal: The high places were not removed from Israel but Asa’s heart was fully devoted all his days
verses.literalPt: Os altos, porém, não foram tirados de Israel; contudo o coração de Asa foi perfeito todos os seus dias.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֞א אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֥י אָבִ֛יו וְקָֽדָשָׁ֖יו בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב וְכֵלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šê ’ā·ḇîw wə·qā·ḏā·šāw bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ wə·ḵê·lîm
verses.literal: And he brought into the house of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated
verses.literalPt: E trouxe, à casa de Deus, as coisas consagradas por seu pai, e as coisas que ele mesmo tinha consagrado: prata, ouro e vasos.

verses.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָיָ֑תָה עַ֛ד שְׁנַת־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mil·ḥā·māh lō hā·yā·ṯāh ‘aḏ šə·naṯ- šə·lō·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš lə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ā·sā
verses.literal: And there was no war until the thirty-fifth . . . year of Asa’s reign
verses.literalPt: E não houve guerra até ao ano trigésimo quinto do reinado de Asa.
